    1. onMessageStream(WebSocketSession, Publisher)

Interface WebSocketMessageStreamHandler<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of the messages
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface WebSocketMessageStreamHandler<T>
Called once for each connection to a WebSocket route, with the messages of the connection as a stream. The messages are decoded like for a WebSocketMessageHandler, and a message is handled once the subscriber requested it. The handler subscribes before it is done. 
ws.onMessageStream(String.class, (session, messages) -> session.sendAllAsync(Flux.from(messages).map(String::toUpperCase)));
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • onMessageStream

      @Nullable CompletionStage<?> onMessageStream(WebSocketSession session, Publisher<T> messages) throws Exception
      Handle the messages of a connection.
      Parameters:
      session - The session of the connection
      messages - The messages of the connection, which completes when the connection closes, and has a single subscriber
      Returns:
      A stage that completes when the handler is done, or null if it is done
      Throws:
      Exception - An error, passed to the error handler
